Money Plant.water: Moderate (2-3 times a week, when topsoil feels dry)
Money Plant.fertilizer: Liquid houseplant fertilizer or vermicompost once a month
Money Plant.sunlight: Indirect bright light (avoid harsh afternoon sun)

Rose Plant.water: Regular (daily in summer, every 2 days in winter)
Rose Plant.fertilizer: Compost, cow dung manure, or NPK rose fertilizer every 15-20 days

Aloe Vera.water: Low (once every 1-2 weeks; let soil dry completely)
Aloe Vera.fertilizer: Succulent fertilizer or mild compost twice a year

Tulsi Plant.water: Moderate (daily light watering in well-drained soil)
Tulsi Plant.fertilizer: Organic compost, vermicompost, or neem cake every 3-4 weeks
Tulsi Plant.sunlight: Full to partial sunlight (4-6 hours daily)

Sunflower.water: Regular (keep soil moist, especially during flowering)
Sunflower.fertilizer: Balanced NPK or organic compost every 2-3 weeks
